svg.text: Anna (Krónan employee) charges 30 kWh at the Krónan workplace site through an N1-owned rented charger

g.text: Org is the SaaS tenant on Straumvakt. Users are humans across one or more orgs. Memberships carry the role.
SaaS tenant — owns every operational row via org_id
Vestigial in rev 3 — see ADR 0009 (proposed drop)
status active · credentials NULL (inert per ADR 0006)
Pilot driver = admin-created record, no signin
Composite PK (org_id, user_id) — same person can be driver in one org, operator in another
9 layers from Org down to Connector. Each tier scoped by org_id. Hardware Catalog is platform-wide (right).
id prop-rvk-hq · org_id → org-kronan · host_id → host-kronan-ws
properties.sites ◄── DSOF, USRF, USRF_PREM, XTRRF, SPVIVF anchor here
timezone Atlantic/Reykjavik · access_level private · power_class lt_50kw
dso_tariff_id → tar-dsof-veitur xtrrf_tariff_id → tar-xtrrf-kronan spvivf_tariff_id → tar-spvivf-kronan
vendor_id → vendor-easee · model_id → model-easee-one · vendor_installation_ref easee-site-12345
id circ-bay1-a · installation_id → inst-ac-bay-1 · site_id → site-hq-parking
properties.site_assets + assets.chargers ◄── CHRGRF anchors here · OWNERSHIP lives here
site_assets: id sa-n1rent-007 · org_id → org-kronan (operator) · kind charger
chargers: site_asset_id sa-n1rent-007 · model_id → model-easee-one · installation_id → inst-ac-bay-1
owner_org_id → org-n1 ◄── HARDWARE OWNED BY N1, OPERATED BY KRÓNAN
id ocpp-id-001 · charger_id → sa-n1rent-007 · ocpp_version ocpp_1_6 · status provisioned
id conn-001-1 · ocpp_identity_id → ocpp-id-001 · connector_index 1 · status Available
Not tenant-scoped — all Orgs see the same vendors and models. Seeded by Sprint 0 + extended via the catalog admin.
id dc-anna-empl · org_id → org-kronan · user_id → u-anna-001
scope null (global) · owner_type workplace · owner_id → org-kronan
When workplace + wrkpf_tariff set, resolver also emits a WRKPF line per session
3 · COMMERCIAL · COST FACTORS · TARIFFS · CONTRACTS · COST CENTERS
Rev 3 (ADR 0008). Factors are catalog rows. Tariff definitions live on anchor entities. Contracts inherit per scope.
Platform-admin extends with INSERT INTO cost_factors. Adding factor #9 post-pilot ≠ migration.
Tariff_definitions reference these rows; anchor entities reference tariff_definitions.
factor DSOF · ToU 1000 öre/kWh avg · attached to site.dso_tariff_id
factor REPF · 1500 öre/kWh flat · attached to installation.retailer_tariff_id
factor XTRRF · 300 öre/min after 30 min · attached to site.xtrrf_tariff_id
factor SPVIVF · 200 öre/kWh · attached to site.spvivf_tariff_id
factor CHRGRF / WRKPF · 5000 öre per session each · attached to charger / driver_contract
compute_rule JSONB DSL drives the tariff engine
Krónan owes Straumvakt for workplace routing service
id cc-rental · payer_org_id → org-kronan · beneficiary_org_id → org-n1
Krónan pays, money settles to N1 (CHRGRF for the rented charger)
id ctr-kronan-root · scope_type org · scope_id NULL · parent NULL
status active · auto-created on Org create
No factor assignments at root — site contract supersedes
id ctr-kronan-hq · scope_type site · scope_id → site-hq-parking
@ all · prio 0 ◄── overridden by driver contract
Anna's REPF cap, this calendar month
Resolver reads + updates atomically with billing_lines write.
In this scenario the cap is NOT hit → all REPF goes to KRONAN_WORKPLACE
One row joins everything: User, Org, Site, Charger, OCPPIdentity, Connector, idTag. Resolver writes billing_lines on session-stop.
